## buddy-sbx login

Authenticate with a Buddy Sandboxes gateway and configure local context

### Synopsis

Login authenticates against a Buddy Sandboxes API using an administrator-issued token,
verifies identity via GET /api/v1/auth/whoami, and saves the connection
context to ~/.buddy/config.yaml.

```
buddy-sbx login [flags] [endpoint]
```

### Examples

```
  # Log in interactively with a prompted token
  buddy-sbx login https://gateway.buddy.example.com

  # Log in using a token passed via flag
  buddy-sbx login --token <admin-token> https://gateway.buddy.example.com

  # Log in using a token read from a local file
  buddy-sbx login --token-file /secrets/admin.token https://gateway.buddy.example.com
```

### Options

```
      --context string      Context name to assign
  -h, --help                help for login
      --local               Use the loopback gateway and ~/.buddy/api-token
      --token string        Authentication bearer token
      --token-file string   Read the authentication bearer token from a private file
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string     Path to config file (default: ~/.buddy/config.yaml)
      --endpoint string   Buddy Gateway endpoint URL (overrides context)
```
